name: LED Bulb PAR38

verification.note: Read from the product having one load, which its group 1 controls, as on other one-load products.

steps.text: Turn off your light fixture and install the bulb.
Turn the light fixture on and leave it on.

notes: Don't connect the bulb to a dimmer; link it to Insteon remotes and switches to dim it.

If the switch or fixture is off, the bulb can't be controlled. If a wall switch controls the fixture, consider wiring it always on, for example by replacing it with an Insteon dimmer switch with its red load wire capped, then linking that switch to the bulb.

steps.text: With the controller in linking mode and the fixture on, screw in the bulb, or unscrew it for a moment and reinsert it.

notes: The bulb has no SET button and links only as a responder: it goes into linking mode each time it is powered up. Put the controller in linking mode first (press and hold its SET button until it beeps; on a multi-button controller, tap the button first).
Linking on power-up can be turned off with software (Disable Linking on Power-up); it is on by default.
For a scene, put the controller in multi-linking mode (hold its SET button until it beeps, then tap it), screw in each bulb one at a time, then tap the controller's SET button to finish.

verification.note: The LED Bulb PAR38 2674 Owner's Manual says the bulb double-beeps when it is linked or unlinked; the LED Bulb Developer Notes say the bulb has no SET button, status LED or beeper. The catalog follows the LED Bulb Developer Notes and gives no confirmation from the bulb.

steps.text: With the controller in unlinking mode and the fixture on, unscrew the bulb for a moment and reinsert it.

notes: Put the controller in unlinking mode first: press and hold its SET button until it beeps (on a multi-button controller, tap the button first), then press and hold it again until it beeps.

verification.note: The LED Bulb PAR38 2674 Owner's Manual says the bulb double-beeps when it is linked or unlinked; the LED Bulb Developer Notes say the bulb has no SET button, status LED or beeper. The catalog follows the LED Bulb Developer Notes and gives no confirmation from the bulb.

notes: Powers up on by default, and can be set to power up to its last state instead.
sources: LED Bulb PAR38 2674 Quick Start Guide
